**Family:** NNN (from `census.tsv`, or say which correction)

**Manuscript:** path under `preprints/` in openai/math, and the commit you read

**The claim:** quote it, with file and line

**What the check will compute:**

**What it will not compute** (the proof steps outside the script):

**Negative control:** what you will change so the check must fail

**Who:** a person, an agent, or a person with an agent (name the system if one helped)

**Want it done by someone else?** Say so and leave the rest empty.
